1.1: Chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum ad sof haolam. veellu hen, bitto, uvat bitto, uvat beno, bat ishto, uvat benah, uvat bittah, chamoto veem chamoto, veem chamiv, achoto meimmo, vaachot immo, vaachot ishto, veeshet achiv meimmo, veeshet achiv shello haya veolamo, vechallato, hare ellu potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum ad sof haolam. vechullan im metu, o meanu, o nitgarshu, o shennimtzeu ayloniyyot, tzarotehen muttarot. vei atta yachol lomar bachamoto uveem chamoto uveem chamiv shennimtzeu ayloniyyot o shemmeenu:
1.2: Ketzad potrot tzarotehen. hayta bitto o achat mikkol haarayot haellu nesua leachiv, velo ishsha acheret, vamet, keshem shebbitto petura, kach tzaratah petura. halcha tzarat bitto venisset leachiv hashsheni, velo ishsha acheret, vamet, keshem shetztzarat bitto petura, kach tzarat tzaratah petura, afillu hen mea. ketzad im metu tzarotehen muttarot, hayta vitto o achat mikkol haarayot haellu nesua leachiv, velo ishsha acheret, meta vitto o nitgarsha, veachar kach met achiv, tzaratah mutteret. vechol hayechola lemaen velo meana, tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet:
1.3: Shesh arayot chamurot meellu, mippene shennesuot laacherim, tzarotehen muttarot. immo, veeshet aviv, vaachot aviv, achoto meaviv, veeshet achi aviv, veeshet achiv meaviv:
1.4: Bet shammay mattirin hatztzarot laachim, uvet hillel osrim. chaltzu, bet shammay poslin min hakkehunna, uvet hillel machshirim. nityabbemu, bet shammay machshirim, uvet hillel poslin. af al pi sheellu osrin veellu mattirin, ellu poslin veellu machshirin, lo nimneu bet shammay millissa nashim mibbet hillel, velo vet hillel mibbet shammay. kol hattohorot vehattumot shehayu ellu metaharin veellu metammein, lo nimneu osin tohorot ellu al gabbe ellu:

2.1: Ketzad eshet achiv shello haya veolamo. shene achim, umet echad mehem, venolad lahen ach, veachar kach yibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv, vamet, harishona yotzet mishshum eshet achiv shello haya veolamo, vehashsheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar vamet, hashsheniyya choletzet velo mityabbemet:
2.2: Shene achim umet echad mehen, veyibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv, veachar kach nolad lahen ach, vamet, harishona yotzet mishshum eshet achiv shello haya veolamo, vehashsheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar, vamet, hashsheniyya choletzet velo mityabbemet. rabbi shimon omer, meyabbem leezo mehen sheyyirtze, o choletz leezo mehen sheyyirtze:
2.3: Kelal amru vayvama. kol shehi issur erva, lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. issurah issur mitzva, veissur kedushsha, choletzet velo mityabbemet. achotah shehi yevimtah, choletzet o mityabbemet:
2.4: Issur mitzva, sheniyyot middivre sofrim. issur kedushsha, almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, uvat yisrael lenatin umamzer:
2.5: Mi sheyyesh lo ach mikkol makom, zokek et eshet achiv leyibbum, veachiv lechol davar, chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo min hashshifcha umin hannachrit. mi sheyyesh lo ben mikkol makom, poter eshet aviv min hayyibbum, vechayyav al makkato veal killato, uveno hu lechol davar, chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo min hashshifcha umin hannachrit:
2.6: Mi shekkiddesh achat mishshete achayot veeno yodea ezo mehen kiddesh, noten get lazo veget lazo. met, velo ach echad, choletz lishtehen. hayu lo shenayim, echad choletz veechad meyabbem. kadmu vechansu, en motziin miyyadam:
2.7: Shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot, ze eno yodea ezo kiddesh, veze eno yodea ezo kiddesh, ze noten shene gittin, veze noten shene gittin. metu, laze ach, velaze ach, ze choletz lishtehen, veze choletz lishtehen. laze echad velaze shenayim, hayyachid choletz lishtehen, vehashshenayim, echad choletz veechad meyabbem, kadmu vechansu, en motziin miyyadam. laze shenayim velaze shenayim, achiv shel ze choletz leachat, veachiv shel ze choletz leachat, achiv shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze, veachiv shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze. kadmu shenayim vechaltzu, lo yeyabbemu hashshenayim, ella echad choletz veechad meyabbem. kadmu vechansu, en motziin miyyadam:
2.8: Mitzva vaggadol leyabbem. veim kadam hakkatan, zacha. hannitan al hashshifcha venishtachrera, o al hannachrit venitgayyera, hare ze lo yichnos. veim kanas en motziin miyyado. hannitan al eshet ish, vehotziuha mittachat yado, af al pi shekkanas, yotzi:
2.9: Hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam, lo yissa et ishto. met, haragtiv, haragnuhu, lo yissa et ishto. rabbi yehuda omer, haragtiv, lo tinnase ishto. haragnuhu, tinnase ishto:
2.10: Hechacham sheasar et haishsha beneder al balah, hare ze lo yissaenna. meana, o shechaltza vefanav, yissaenna, mippene shehu vet din. vechullan shehayu lahem nashim, vametu, muttarot linnase lahem. vechullan shennisseu laacherim venitgarshu o shennitalmenu, muttarot linnase lahen. vechullan muttarot livnehem o laachehen:

3.1: Arbaa achin, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, umetu hannesuim et haachayot, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. veim kadmu vechansu, yotziu. rabbi eliezer omer, bet shammay omrim yekayyemu, uvet hillel omrim yotziu:
3.2: Hayta achat mehen asura al haechad issur erva, asur bah umuttar baachotah, vehashsheni asur bishtehen issur mitzva veissur kedushsha, choletzet velo mityabbemet:
3.3: Hayta achat mehen asura al ze issur erva, vehashsheniyya asura al ze issur erva, haasura laze mutteret laze, vehaasura laze mutteret laze. vezo hi sheamru, achotah keshehi yevimtah, o choletzet o mityabbemet:
3.4: Shelosha achin, shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot, o ishsha uvittah, o ishsha uvat bittah, o ishsha uvat benah, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. verabbi shimon poter. hayta achat mehen asura alav issur erva, asur bah umuttar baachotah. issur mitzva o issur kedushsha, choltzot velo mityabbemot:
3.5: Shelosha achin, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, veechad mufne, met echad mibbaale achayot, veasa vah mufne maamar, veachar kach met achiv hashsheni, bet shammay omrim, ishto immo, vehalla tetze mishshum achot ishsha. uvet hillel omrim, motzi et ishto veget uvachalitza, veeshet achiv bachalitza. zo hi sheamru, oy lo al ishto veoy lo al eshet achiv:
3.6: Shelosha achin, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, met echad mibbaale achayot, vechanas nasuy nachrit et ishto, vamet, harishona yotza mishshum achot ishsha, usheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar, vamet, nachrit choletzet velo mityabbemet. shelosha achim, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, met hannasuy nachrit, vechanas echad mibbaale achayot et ishto, vamet, harishona yotza mishshum achot ishsha, usheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar, vamet, nachrit choletzet velo mityabbemet:
3.7: Shelosha achim, shenayim mehen nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, met echad mibbaale achayot, vechanas nasuy nachrit et ishto, umeta ishto shel sheni, veachar kach met nasuy nachrit, hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa echat. shelosha achim, shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot, veechad nasuy nachrit, geresh echad mibbaale achayot et ishto, umet nasuy nachrit, uchenasah hammegaresh, vamet, zo hi sheamru, vechullan shemmetu o nitgarshu, tzarotehen muttarot:
3.8: Vechullan shehayu vahen kiddushin o gerushin besafek, hare ellu tzarot, choltzot velo mityabbemot. ketzad sefek kiddushin, zarak lah kiddushin, safek karov lo safek karov lah, zehu sefek kiddushin. sefek gerushin, katav bichtav yado veen alav edim, yesh alav edim veen bo zeman, yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad, zehu sefek gerushin:
3.9: Shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nachriot, umet achad mehen, veasa vah hashsheni maamar, vamet, hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot, sheneemar (Devarim 25), umet achad mehem yevamah yavo aleha, shealeha zikkat yavam echad, velo shealeha zikkat shene yevamin. rabbi shimon omer, meyabbem leezo sheyyirtze, vecholetz lashsheniyya. shene achin nesuin lishte achayot, umet achad mehen, veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni, hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa echat:
3.10: Shenayim shekiddeshu shete nashim, uvishat kenisatan lachuppa hechelifu et shel ze laze, veet shel ze laze, hare ellu chayyavim mishshum eshet ish. hayu achin, mishshum eshet ach. veim hayu achayot, mishshum ishsha el achotah. veim hayu niddot, mishshum nidda. umafrishin otan shelosha chodashim, shemma meubbarot hen. veim hayu ketannot sheenan reuyot leled, machazirin otan miyyad. veim hayu chohanot, nifselu min hatteruma:

4.1: Hacholetz livimto, venimtzet meubberet veyalada, bizman shehavvalad shel keyama, hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo fesalah min hakkehunna. en havvalad shel keyama, hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura vikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna:
4.2: Hakkones et yevimto, venimtzet meubberet veyalada, bizman shehavvalad shel keyama, yotzi vechayyavin bakkarban. veim en havvalad shel keyama, yekayyem. safek ben tisha larishon, safek ben shiva laacharon, yotzi vehavvalad kasher, vechayyavin beasham taluy:
4.3: Shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim, modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret, venotenet, vekayyam. meta, ma yaasu vichtubbatah uvannechasim hannichnasim veyotzin immah, bet shammay omrim, yachaloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan, ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasim veyotzim immah bechezkat yorshe haav:
4.4: Kenasah, hare hi cheishto lechol davar, uvilvad shettehe chetubbatah al nichse valah harishon:
4.5: Mitzva vaggadol leyabbem. lo ratza, mehallechin al kol haachin. lo ratzu, chozrin etzel gadol veomrim lo, alecha mitzva, o chalotz o yabbem:
4.6: Tala vakkatan ad sheyyagdil, o vaggadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam, o vacheresh, o vashshote, en shomin lo, ella omrim lo, alecha mitzva, o chalotz o yabbem:
4.7: Hacholetz livimto, hare hu cheechad min haachin lannachala. veim yesh sham av, nechasim shel av. hakkones et yevimto, zacha vannechasim shel achiv. rabbi yehuda omer, ben kach uven kach, im yesh sham av, nechasim shel av. hacholetz livimto, hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura vikrovav. hu asur beimmah, uveem immah, uveem aviha, uvevittah, uvevat bittah, uvevat benah, uvaachotah bizman shehi kayyemet. vehaachin muttarin. vehi asura veaviv, uvaavi aviv, uvivno, uveven beno, beachiv, uveven achiv. muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato, veasur betzarat kerovat chalutzato:
4.8: Hacholetz livimto, venasa achiv et achotah, vamet, choletzet velo mityabbemet. vechen hamegaresh et ishto, venasa achiv et achotah, vamet, hare zo petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum:
4.9: Shomeret yavam shekkiddesh achiv et achotah, mishshum rabbi yehuda ven betera amru, omrim lo, hameten ad sheyyaase achicha haggadol maase. chalatz lah achiv, o chenasah, yichnos et ishto. meta hayyevama, yichnos et ishto. met yavam, yotzi et ishto veget, veeshet achiv bachalitza:
4.10: Hayevama lo tachalotz velo tityabbem, ad sheyyesh lah shelosha chodashim. vechen kol shear hannashim lo yitarsu velo yinnasu, ad sheyyihyu lahen shelosha chodashim. echad betulot veechad beulot, echad gerushot veechad almanot, echad nesuot veechad arusot. rabbi yehuda omer, hannesuot yitarsu, vehaarusot yinnasu, chutz min haarusot shebbihuda, mippene shellibbo gas bah. rabbi yose omer, kol hannashim yitarsu, chutz min haalmana, mippene haibbul:
4.11: Arbaa achin nesuin arba nashim, vametu, im ratza haggadol shebbahem leyabbem et kullan, harshut beyado. mi shehaya nasuy lishte nashim, vamet, biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah. hayta achat keshera, veachat pesula, im haya choletz, choletz lappesula. veim haya meyabbem, meyabbem lakkeshera:
4.12: Hammachazir gerushato, vehannose chalutzato, vehannose kerovat chalutzato, yotzi, vehavvalad mamzer, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, en havvalad mamzer. umodim benose kerovat gerushato, shehavvalad mamzer:
4.13: Ezehu mamzer, kol sheer basar shehu velo yavo divre rabbi akiva. shimon hattimni omer, kol shechayyavin alav karet bide shamayim. vahalacha chidvarav. rabbi yehoshua omer, kol shechayyavim alav mitat bet din. amar rabbi shimon ben azzay, matzati megillat yuchasin birushalayim vechatuv bah, ish peloni mamzer meeshet ish, lekayyem divre rabbi yehoshua. ishto shemmeta, muttar baachotah. gershah vameta, muttar baachotah. nisset leacher vameta, muttar baachotah. yevimto shemmeta, muttar baachotah. chalatz lah vameta, muttar baachotah:

5.1: Rabban gamliel omer, en get achar get, velo maamar achar maamar, velo veila achar beila, velo chalitza achar chalitza. vachachamim omrim, yesh get achar get, veyesh maamar achar maamar, aval lo achar beila velo achar chalitza kelum:
5.2: Ketzad. asa maamar bivimto, venatan lah get, tzericha hemennu chalitza. asa maamar vachalitza, tzericha hemennu get. asa maamar uvaal, hare zo chemitzvatah:
5.3: Natan get veasa maamar, tzericha get vachalitza. natan get uvaal, tzericha get vachalitza. natan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum. chalatz veasa maamar, natan get, uvaal, o vaal veasa maamar, natan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum. achat yevama achat leyavam echad, veachat shete yevamot leyavam echad:
5.4: Ketzad. asa maamar bazo umaamar bazo, tzerichot shene gittin vachalitza. maamar bazo veget bazo, tzericha get vachalitza. maamar bazo uvaal et zo, tzerichot shene gittin vachalitza. maamar bazo vechalatz lazo, harishona tzericha get. get lazo veget lazo, tzerichot hemennu chalitza. get lazo uvaal et zo, tzericha get vachalitza. get lazo umaamar bazo, tzericha get vachalitza. get lazo vechalatz lazo, en achar chalitza kelum:
5.5: Chalatz vechalatz, o chalatz veasa maamar, natan get uvaal, o vaal uvaal, o vaal veasa maamar, natan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum, ben yavam echad lishte yevamot, ben shene yevamin livama echat:
5.6: Chalatz veasa maamar, natan get uvaal, o vaal veasa maamar, venatan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum, ben battechilla, ben baemtza, ben bassof. vehabbeila, bizman shehi vattechilla, en achareha chelum. baemtza uvassof, yesh achareha chelum. rabbi nechemya omer, achat beila veachat chalitza, ben battechilla, ben baemtza, ben bassof, en achareha chelum:

6.1: Habba al yevimto, ben beshogeg, ben bemezid, ben beones, ben beratzon, afillu hu shogeg vehi mezida, hu mezid vehi shogeget, hu anus vehi lo anusa, hi anusa vehu lo anus, echad hameare veechad haggomer, kana, velo chalak ben bia levia:
6.2: Vechen habba al achat mikkol haarayot shebbattora, o fesulot, kegon almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, pasal. velo chalak ben bia levia:
6.3: Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, min haerusin lo yochlu vatteruma. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon machshirin. nitarmelu o nitgarshu, min hannissuin pesulot, min haerusin kesherot:
6.4: Kohen gadol lo yissa almana, ben almana min haerusin, ben almana min hannissuin, velo yissa et habbogeret. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret. lo yissa et mukkat etz. eres et haalmana, venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol, yichnos. umaase vihoshua ben gamla shekkiddesh et marta vat baytos, uminnahu hammelech lihyot kohen gadol, uchenasah. shomeret yavam shennafla lifne chohen hedyot, venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol, af al pi sheasa vah maamar, hare ze lo yichnos. kohen gadol shemmet achiv, choletz velo meyabbem:
6.5: Kohen hedyot lo yissa aylonit, ella im ken yesh lo ishsha uvanim. rabbi yehuda omer, af al pi sheyyesh lo ishsha uvanim, lo yissa aylonit, shehi zona haamura vattora. vachachamim omrim, en zona ella giyyoret umeshuchreret veshennivala veilat zenut:
6.6: Lo yibbatel adam mipperiyya ureviyya, ella im ken yesh lo vanim. bet shammay omrim, shene zecharim. uvet hillel omrim, zachar unekeva, shenneemar, (Bereshit 5) zachar unekeva beraam. nasa ishsha, veshaha immah eser shanim, velo yalda, eno rashshay libbatel. gershah, mutteret linnase leacher. verashshay hashsheni lishhot immah eser shanim. veim hippila, mone mishshaa shehippila. haish metzuvve al periyya ureviyya, aval lo haishsha. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, al shenehem hu omer (Bereshit 1), vayvarech otam elohim vayyomer lahem elohim peru urevu:

7.1: Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, hichnisa lo avde melog veavde tzon barzel, avde melog lo yochlu vatteruma, avde tzon barzel yochelu. veellu hen avde melog, im metu, metu lah, veim hotiru, hotiru lah. af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotan, hare ellu lo yochlu vatteruma. veellu hen avde tzon barzel, im metu, metu lo, veim hotiru, hotiru lo. hoil vehu chayyav beacharayutan, hare ellu yochlu vatteruma:
7.2: Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehichnisa lo avadim, ben avde melog, ben avde tzon barzel, hare ellu yochlu vatteruma. uvat kohen shennisset leyisrael, vehichnisa lo, ben avde melog, ben avde tzon barzel, hare ellu lo yochlu vatteruma:
7.3: Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, umet, vehinnichah meubberet, lo yochlu avadeha batteruma, mippene chelko shel ubbar, shehaubbar posel veeno maachil, divre rabbi yose. amru lo, meachar sheheadta lanu al bat yisrael lechohen, af bat kohen lechohen, umet, vehinnichah meubberet, lo yochlu avadeha vatteruma, mippene chelko shel ubbar:
7.4: Haubbar, vehayyavam, vehaerusin, vehacheresh, uven tesha shanim veyom echad, poslin velo maachilin. safek shehu ven tesha shanim veyom echad safek sheeno, safek hevi shete searot safek shello hevi, nafal habbayit alav veal bat achiv veen yadua e ze met rishon, tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet:
7.5: Haones, vehamefatte, vehashshote, lo foslim velo maachilim. veim enam reuyin lavo veyisrael, hare ellu foslin. ketzad, yisrael shebba al bat kohen, tochal batteruma. ibbera, lo tochal batteruma. nechtach haubbar bemeeha, tochal. kohen shebba al bat yisrael, lo tochal batteruma. ibbera, lo tochal. yalda, tochal. nimtza kocho shel ben gadol mishshel av. haeved posel mishshum bia, veeno fosel mishshum zara. ketzad, bat yisrael lechohen, bat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu ven, vehalach habben venichbash al hashshifcha, veyalda hemennu ven, hare ze eved. hayta em aviv bat yisrael lechohen lo tochal batteruma. bat kohen leyisrael, tochal batteruma. mamzer posel umaachil. ketzad, bat yisrael lechohen, uvat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu vat, vehalcha habbat venisset leeved, o legoy, veyalda hemennu ven, hare ze mamzer. hayta em immo vat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma. bat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma:
7.6: Kohen gadol peamim shehu fosel. ketzad, bat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu vat, vehalcha habbat venisset lechohen, veyalda hemennu ven, hare ze rauy lihyot kohen gadol omed umeshammesh al gabbe hammizbeach, maachil et immo ufosel et em immo, vezot omeret, lo chivni kohen gadol, shehu posleni min hatteruma:

8.1: Hearel vechol hattemeim, lo yochlu vatteruma. neshehen veavdehen, yochlu vatteruma. petzua dakka ucherut shafcha, hen veavdehen yochlu, uneshehen lo yochelu. veim lo yedaah mishshennaasa fetzua dakka ucherut shafcha, hare ellu yochelu:
8.2: Ezehu fetzua dakka, kol shenniftzeu habbetzim shello, vaafillu achat mehen. ucherut shafcha, kol shennichrat haggid. veim nishtayyer mehaatara afillu kechut hassaara, kasher. petzua dakka ucherut shafcha, muttarin begiyyoret umeshuchreret, veenan asurin ella millavo vakkahal, shenneemar (Devarim 23), lo yavo fetzua dakka ucherut shafcha bikhal Adonai:
8.3: Ammoni umoavi, asurim, veissuran issur olam, aval nekevotehem muttarot miyyad. mitzri vaadomi enam asurim ella ad shelosha dorot, echad zecharim veechad nekevot. rabbi shimon mattir et hannekevot miyyad. amar rabbi shimon, kal vachomer haddevarim, uma im bimkom sheasar et hazzecharim issur olam, hittir et hannekevot miyyad, mekom shello asar et hazzecharim ella ad shelosha dorot, eno din shennattir et hannekevot miyyad. amru lo, im halacha nekabbel, veim laddin, yesh teshuva. amar lahem, lo chi, halacha ani omer. mamzerin unetinin, asurin, veissuran issur olam, echad zecharim, veechad nekevot:
8.4: Amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati shehassaris choletz, vecholtzin leishto, vehassaris lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, veen li lefaresh. amar rabbi akiva, ani afaresh. seris adam choletz vecholtzin leishto, mippene shehayta lo sheat hakkosher. seris chamma lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, mippene shello hayta lo sheat hakkosher. rabbi elazar omer, lo chi, ella seris chamma choletz, vecholtzin leishto, mippene sheyyesh lo refua. seris adam lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, mippene sheen lo refua. heid rabbi yehoshua ben betera al ben megusat shehaya virushalayim seris adam, veyibbemu et ishto, lekayyem divre rabbi akiva:
8.5: Hassaris lo choletz velo meyabbem. vechen aylonit lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. hassaris shechalatz livimto, lo fesalah. bealah, pesalah, mippene shehi veilat zenut. vechen aylonit shechaltzu lah achin, lo fesaluha. bealuha, pesaluha, mippene shebbeilatah beilat zenut:
8.6: Seris chamma kohen shennasa vat yisrael, maachilah batteruma. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, anderoginos kohen shennasa vat yisrael, maachilah batteruma. rabbi yehuda omer, tumtum shennikra venimtza zachar, lo yachalotz, mippene shehu chesaris. anderoginos nose, aval lo nissa. rabbi eliezer omer, anderoginos chayyavim alav sekila, kezachar:

9.1: Yesh muttarot levaalehen vaasurot liyvamehen, muttarot liyvamehen vaasurot levaalehen, muttarot laellu velaellu, vaasurot laellu velaellu. veelu muttarot levaalehen vaasurot liyvamehen, kohen hedyot shennasa et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen gadol, chalal shennasa cheshera veyesh lo ach kasher, yisrael shennasa vat yisrael veyesh lo ach mamzer, mamzer shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael, muttarot levaalehen vaasurot liyvamehen:
9.2: Veellu muttarot liyvamehen vaasurot levaalehen. kohen gadol shekkiddesh et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen hedyot, kasher shennasa chalala veyesh lo ach chalal, yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach mamzer, mamzer shennasa vat yisrael veyesh lo ach yisrael, muttarot liyvamehen vaasurot levaalehen. asurot laellu velaellu, kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen gadol o chohen hedyot, kasher shennasa chalala veyesh lo ach kasher, yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael, mamzer shennasa vat yisrael veyesh lo ach mamzer, asurot laellu velaellu. ushear kol hannashim, muttarot levaalehen veliyvamehen:
9.3: Sheniyyot middivre sofrim, sheniyya labbaal velo sheniyya layyavam, asura labbaal umutteret layyavam. sheniyya layyavam velo sheniyya labbaal, asura layyavam umutteret labbaal. sheniyya laze velaze, asura laze velaze. en lah lo chetubba, velo ferot, velo mezonot, velo velaot, vehavvalad kasher, vechofin oto lehotzi. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer, yesh lahen ketubba:
9.4: Bat yisrael meoreset lechohen, meubberet mikkohen, shomeret yavam lechohen, vechen bat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma. bat yisrael meoreset lelevi, meubberet millevi, shomeret yavam lelevi, vechen bat levi leyisrael, lo tochal bammaaser. bat levi meoreset lechohen, meubberet mikkohen, shomeret yavam lechohen, vechen bat kohen lelevi, lo tochal lo vatteruma velo vammaaser:
9.5: Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, tochal batteruma. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal batteruma. nisset lelevi, tochal bammaaser. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal bammaaser. nisset leyisrael, lo tochal lo vatteruma, velo vammaaser. met, velah hemennu ven, lo tochal lo vatteruma velo vammaaser. met benah miyyisrael, tochal bammaaser. met benah millevi, tochal batteruma. met benah mikkohen, lo tochal lo vatteruma velo vammaaser:
9.6: Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma. met velah hemennu ven, lo tochal batteruma. nisset lelevi, tochal bammaaser. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal bammaaser. nisset lechohen, tochal batteruma. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal batteruma. met benah mikkohen, lo tochal batteruma. met benah millevi, lo tochal bammaaser. met benah miyyisrael, chozeret levet aviha. veal zo neemar (Vayikra 22), veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel:

10.1: Haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah, met balech, venisset, veachar kach ba valah, tetze mizze umizze, utzericha get mizze umizze. veen lah ketubba velo ferot velo mezonot velo velaot, lo al ze velo al ze. im natla mizze umizze, tachazir. vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. velo ze vaze mittammein lah, velo ze vaze zakkain lo vimtziatah velo vemaase yadeha, velo vahafarat nedareha. hayta vat yisrael, nifsela min hakkehunna, uvat levi min hammaaser, uvat kohen min hatteruma. veen yorshim shel ze veyorshim shel ze yorshim et ketubbatah. veim metu, achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyabbemin. rabbi yose omer, ketubbatah al nichse valah harishon. rabbi elazar omer, harishon zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha. verabbi shimon omer, biatah o chalitzatah meachiv shel rishon poteret tzaratah, veen havvalad mimmennu mamzer. veim nisset shello virshut, mutteret lachazor lo:
10.2: Nisset al pi vet din, tetze, ufetura min hakkarban. lo nisset al pi vet din, tetze, vechayyevet bakkarban. yafe koach bet din, sheppotrah min hakkarban. horuha vet din linnase, vehalcha vekilkela, chayyevet bakkarban, shello hittiruha ella linnase:
10.3: Haishsha shehalach baalah uvenah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah, met balech veachar kach met benech, venisset, veachar kach amru lah, chilluf hayu haddevarim, tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer. amru lah, met benech veachar kach met balech, venityabbema, veachar kach amru lah, chilluf hayu haddevarim, tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer. amru lah, met balech, venisset, veachar kach amru lah, kayyam haya umet, tetze, vehavvalad rishon mamzer, vehaacharon eno mamzer. amru lah, met balech, venitkaddesha, veachar kach ba valah, mutteret lachazor lo. af al pi shennatan lah acharon get, lo fesalah min hakkehunna. et zo darash rabbi elazar ben matya, veishsha gerusha meishah (Vayikra 21), velo meish sheeno ishah:
10.4: Mi shehalcha ishto limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lo, meta ishtecha, venasa et achotah, veachar kach bat ishto, mutteret lachazor lo. hu muttar bikrovot sheniyya, usheniyya mutteret bikrovav. veim meta rishona, muttar bashsheniyya. amru lo, meta ishtecha, venasa et achotah, veachar kach amru lo, kayyemet hayta, umeta, havvalad rishon mamzer, vehaacharon eno mamzer. rabbi yose omer, kol shepposel al yede acherim, posel al yede atzmo. vechol sheen posel al yede acherim, eno fosel al yede atzmo:
10.5: Amru lo, meta ishtecha, venasa achotah meaviha, meta, venasa achotah meimmah, meta, venasa achotah meaviha, meta, venasa achotah meimmah, venimtzeu chullan kayyamot, muttar barishona, bashshelishit, uvachamishit, ufotrot tzarotehen, veasur bashsheniyya uvarviit, veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah. veim ba al hashsheniyya leachar mitat harishona, muttar bashsheniyya uvarviit, ufotrot tzarotehen, veasur bashshelishit uvachamishit, veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah:
10.6: Ben tesha shanim veyom echad, hu fosel al yede achin, vehaachim poslin al yado, ella shehu fosel techilla, vehaachin poslin techilla vasof. ketzad, ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, pasal al yede achin. bau aleha achin, veasu vah maamar, natnu get o chaltzu, paslu al yado:
10.7: Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, veachar kach ba aleha achiv shehu ven tesha shanim veyom echad, pasal al yado. rabbi shimon omer, lo fasal:
10.8: Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, veachar kach ba al tzaratah, pasal al yede atzmo. rabbi shimon omer, lo fasal. ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, umet, choletzet velo mityabbemet. nasa ishsha umet, hare zo fetura:
10.9: Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, umishshehigdil nasa ishsha acheret umet, im lo yada et harishona mishshehigdil, harishona choletzet velo mityabbemet, vehashsheniyya o choletzet o mityabbemet. rabbi shimon omer, meyabbem leezo sheyyirtze, vecholetz lashsheniyya. echad shehu ven tesha shanim veyom echad, veechad shehu ven esrim shana shello hevi shete searot:

11.1: Nosin al haanusa veal hamefutta. haones vehamefatte al hannesua, chayyav. nose adam anusat aviv umefuttat aviv, anusat beno umefuttat beno. rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv umefuttat aviv:
11.2: Haggiyyoret shennitgayyeru vaneha immah, lo choltzin velo meyabbemin, afillu horato shel rishon shello vikdushsha veledato vikdushsha, vehashsheni horato veledato vikdushsha. vechen shifcha shennishtachreru vaneha immah:
11.3: Chamesh nashim shennitarvu valdotehen, higdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu, arbaa choltzin leachat, veechad meyabbem otah. hu ushelosha choltzim leacheret, veechad meyabbem. nimtzeu arba chalitzot veyibbum lechol achat veechat:
11.4: Haishsha shennitarev veladah bivlad kallatah, higdilu hattaarovot, venasu nashim, umetu, bene hakkalla choltzin velo meyabbemin, shehu sefek eshet achiv sefek eshet achi aviv. uvene hazzekena, o choltzin o meyabbemin, shehu sefek eshet achiv veeshet ben achiv. metu hakkesherim, bene hattaarovot livne hazzekena choltzin velo meyabbemin, shehu sefek eshet achiv veeshet achi aviv, uvene hakkalla, echad choletz veechad meyabbem:
11.5: Kohenet shennitarev veladdah bivlad shifchatah, hare ellu ochlim batteruma, vecholkim chelek echad baggoren, veenan mittammein lemetim, veen nosin nashim, ben kesherot ben pesulot. higdilu hattaarovot, veshichreru ze et ze, nosin nashim reuyot lakkehunna, veenan mittammein lemetim. veim nitmeu, enan sofgin et haarbaim. veenan ochlim batteruma. veim achlu, enan meshallemin keren vachomesh. veenan cholkin al haggoren. umochrin et hatteruma, vehaddamim shellahem. veenan cholkim bekadshe hammikdash, veen notnin lahem kadashim, veen motziin shellahem miyyadam, ufeturin min hazzeroa umin hallechayayim umin hakkeva, uvechoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev, venotnin alav chumre chohanim vechumre yisreelim:
11.6: Mi shello shahata achar bala shelosha chodashim venisset, veyalda, veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon. hayu lah banim min harishon uvanim min hashsheni, choltzin velo meyabbemin. vechen hu lahem, choletz velo meyabbem. hayu lo achim min harishon veachim min hashsheni shello meotah haem, hu choletz umeyabbem, vehem, echad choletz veechad meyabbem:
11.7: Haya echad yisrael veechad kohen, nose ishsha reuya lechohen, veeno mittamme lemetim, veim nitma, eno sofeg et haarbaim. veeno ochel batteruma, veim achal, eno meshallem keren vachomesh. veeno cholek al haggoren. umocher hatteruma, vehaddamim shello. veeno cholek bekadshe hammikdash, veen notnim lo et hakkadashim, veen motziin et shello miyyado. ufatur min hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva. uvechoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev. venotnin alav chumre chohanim vechumre yisreelim. hayu shenehem kohanim, hu onen alehem, vehem onnim alav. hu eno mittamme lahem, vehem enan mittammein lo. hu eno yoresh otan, aval hem yorshin oto. ufatur al makkato veal killato shel ze veshel ze, veole vemishmaro shel ze veshel ze, veeno cholek. im hayu shenehem bemishmar echad, notel chelek echad:

12.1: Mitzvat chalitza bishlosha dayyanin, vaafillu shelashtan hedyotot. chaltza veminal, chalitzatah keshera. beanpilin, chalitzatah pesula. besandal sheyyesh lo akev, kasher. vesheen lo akev, pasul. min haarkubba ulematta, chalitzatah keshera. min haarkubba ulemala, chalitzatah pesula:
12.2: Chaltza vesandal sheeno shello, o vesandal shel etz, o veshel semol bayyamin, chalitzatah keshera. chaltza vegadol shehu yachol lahaloch bo, o vekatan shehu chofe et rov raglo, chalitzatah keshera. chaltza vallayla, chalitzatah keshera, verabbi eliezer posel. bassemol, chalitzatah pesula, verabbi eliezer machshir:
12.3: Chaltza verakka, aval lo kara, chalitzatah keshera. kara verakka, aval lo chaltza, chalitzatah pesula. chaltza vekara, aval lo rakka, rabbi eliezer omer, chalitzatah pesula. rabbi akiva omer, chalitzatah keshera. amar rabbi eliezer, kacha yease (Devarim 25), kol davar shehu maase, meakkev. amar lo rabbi akiva, mishsham reaya, kacha yease laish, kol davar shehu maase vaish:
12.4: Hacheresh shennechelatz vehachereshet shechaltza, vehacholetzet lakkatan, chalitzatah pesula. ketanna shechaltza, tachalotz mishshettagdil. veim lo chaltza, chalitzatah pesula:
12.5: Chaltza vishnayim, o vishlosha, venimtza echad mehen karov o fasul, chalitzatah pesula. rabbi shimon verabbi yochanan hassandelar machshirin. umaase veechad shechalatz beno levenah bevet haasurin, uva maase lifne rabbi akiva vehichshir:
12.6: Mitzvat chalitza. ba hu vivimto levet din, vehen massiin lo etza hahogenet lo, shenneemar, (Devarim 25) vekaru lo zikne iro vedibberu elav. vehi omeret, meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael, lo ava yabbemi. vehu omer, lo chafatzti lekachtah. uvilshon hakkodesh hayu omrim. veniggesha yevimto elav leene hazzekenim vechaltza naalo meal raglo veyarka befanav, rok hannire laddayyanim. veanta veamra kacha yease laish asher lo yivne et bet achiv, ad kan hayu makrin. ucheshehikra rabbi hurkenos tachat haela bichfar etam vegamar et kol happarasha, huchzeku lihyot gomrin kol happarasha. venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal. mitzva vaddayyanin, velo mitzva vattalmidim. rabbi yehuda omer, mitzva al kol haomdim sham lomar, chalutz hannaal, chalutz hannaal, chalutz hannaal:

13.1: Bet shammay omrim, en memaanin ella arusot. uvet hillel omrim, arusot unesuot. bet shammay omrim, babbaal velo vayyavam. uvet hillel omrim, babbaal uvayyavam. bet shammay omrim, befanav. uvet hillel omrim, befanav veshello vefanav. bet shammay omrim, bevet din. uvet hillel omrim, bevet din veshello vevet din. amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay, memaenet vehi ketanna, afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim. amru lahen bet shammay, en benot yisrael hefker, ella memaenet umamtenet ad shettagdil, utemaen vetinnase:
13.2: Ezo hi ketanna shetztzericha lemaen, kol shehissiuha immah veacheha ledatah. hissiuha shello ledatah, enah tzericha lemaen. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, kol tinoket sheenah yechola lishmor kiddusheha, enah tzericha lemaen. rabbi eliezer omer, en maase ketanna chelum, ella chimfutta. bat yisrael lechohen, lo tochal batteruma. bat kohen leyisrael, tochal batteruma:
13.3: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, kol akkava shehi min haish, keillu hi ishto. vechol akkava sheenah min haish, keillu enah ishto:
13.4: Hamemaenet baish, hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo fesalah min hakkehunna. natan lah get, hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura vikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna. natan lah get vehechezirah, meana vo venisset leacher venitarmela o nitgarsha, mutteret lachazor lo. meana vo vehechezirah, natan lah get venisset leacher venitarmela o nitgarsha, asura lachazor lo. ze hakkelal, get achar meun, asura lachazor lo. meun achar get, mutteret lachazor lo:
13.5: Hamemaenet baish venisset leacher vegershah, leacher umeana vo, leacher vegershah, leacher umeana vo, kol sheyyatzat hemennu veget, asura lachazor lo. bemeun, mutteret lachazor lo:
13.6: Hamegaresh et haishsha vehechezirah, mutteret layyavam. verabbi eliezer oser. vechen hamegaresh et hayetoma vehechezirah, mutteret layyavam. verabbi eliezer oser. ketanna shehissiah aviha venitgarsha, kitoma vechayye haav. hechezirah, divre hakkol, asura layyavam:
13.7: Shene achin nesuin lishte achayot yetomot ketannot, umet balah shel achat mehen, tetze mishshum achot ishsha. vechen shete chershot gedola uketanna, met balah shel ketanna, tetze hakketanna mishshum achot ishsha. met balah shel gedola, rabbi eliezer omer, melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen bo. rabban gamliel omer, im meana, meana. veim lav, tamtin ad shettagdil, vetetze hallazu mishshum achot ishsha. rabbi yehoshua omer, i lo al ishto, vei lo al eshet achiv. motzi et ishto veget, veeshet achiv bachalitza:
13.8: Mi shehaya nasuy lishte yetomot ketannot, umet, biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah. vechen shete chershot. ketanna vechereshet, en biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah. pikkachat vechereshet, biat happikkachat poteret et hachereshet, veen biat hachereshet poteret et happikkachat. gedola uketanna, biat haggedola foteret et hakketanna, veen biat hakketanna foteret et haggedola:
13.9: Mi shehaya nasuy lishte yetomot ketannot, umet, ba yavam al harishona, vechazar uva al hashsheniyya, o shebba achiv al hashsheniyya, lo fasal et harishona. vechen shete chershot. ketanna vechereshet, ba yavam al hakketanna, vechazar uva al hachereshet, o shebba achiv al hachereshet, lo fasal et hakketanna. ba yavam al hachereshet, vechazar uva al hakketanna, o shebba achiv al hakketanna, pasal et hachereshet:
13.10: Pikkachat vechereshet, ba yavam al happikkachat, vechazar uva al hachereshet, o shebba achiv al hachereshet, lo fasal et happikkachat. ba yavam al hachereshet vechazar uva al happikkachat, o shebba achiv al happikkachat, pasal et hachereshet:
13.11: Gedola uketanna, ba yavam al haggedola, vechazar uva al hakketanna, o shebba achiv al hakketanna, lo fasal et haggedola. ba yavam al hakketanna, vechazar uva al haggedola, o shebba achiv al haggedola, pasal et hakketanna. rabbi elazar omer, melammedin hakketanna shettemaen bo:
13.12: Yavam katan shebba al yevama ketanna, yigdelu ze im ze. ba al yevama gedola, tegaddelennu. hayevama sheamra betoch sheloshim yom, lo nivalti, kofin oto sheyyachalotz lah. leachar sheloshim yom, mevakshim hemennu sheyyachalotz lah. uvizman shehu mode, afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh kofin oto sheyyachalotz lah:
13.13: Hannoderet hanaa miyvamah bechayye valah, kofin oto sheyyachalotz lah. leachar mitat balah, mevakshin hemennu sheyyachalotz lah. veim nitkavvena lechach, afillu vechayye valah, mevakshin hemennu sheyyachalotz lah:

14.1: Cheresh shennasa fikkachat, ufikkeach shennasa chereshet, im ratza yotzi, veim ratza yekayyem. keshem shehu chones birmiza, kach hu motzi virmiza. pikkeach shennasa fikkachat, venitcharsha, im ratza yotzi, veim ratza yekayyem. nishtattet, lo yotzi. nitcharesh hu o nishtatta, eno motzi olamit. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, mippene ma haishsha shennitcharsha yotza, vehaish shennitcharesh eno motzi. amru lo, eno dome haish hamegaresh leishsha mitgareshet, shehaishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah, vehaish eno motzi ella lirtzono:
14.2: Heid rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha, shehi yotza veget. amru lo, af zo chayyotze vah:
14.3: Shene achim chershim, nesuim lishte achayot chershot, o lishte achayot pikchot, o lishte achayot, achat chereshet veachat pikkachat, o shete achayot chershot nesuot lishne achim pikchim, o lishne achim chershin o lishne achin, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, hare ellu feturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. veim hayu nachriyyot, yichnosu, veim ratzu lehotzi, yotziu:
14.4: Shene achim, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuim lishte achayot pikchot, met cheresh baal happikkachat, ma yaase fikkeach baal happikkachat, tetze mishshum achot ishsha. met pikkeach baal happikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal pikkachat, motzi ishto veget, veeshet achiv asura leolam.
14.5: Shene achim pikchim nesuim lishte achayot, achat chereshet veachat pikkachat, met pikkeach baal chereshet, ma yaase fikkeach baal pikkachat, tetze mishshum achot ishsha. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase fikkeach baal hachereshet, motzi et ishto veget, veet eshet achiv bachalitza.
14.6: Shene achim, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuim lishte achayot, achat chereshet veachat pikkachat, met cheresh baal chereshet, ma yaase fikkeach baal pikkachat, tetze mishshum achot ishsha. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet, motzi ishto veget, veeshet achiv asura leolam.
14.7: Shene achim, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuim lishte nachriyyot pikchot, met cheresh baal pikkachat, ma yaase fikkeach baal pikkachat, o choletz o meyabbem. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal pikkachat, kones, veeno motzi leolam.
14.8: Shene achim pikchim nesuim lishte nachriyyot, achat pikkachat veachat chereshet, met pikkeach baal chereshet, ma yaase fikkeach baal pikkachat, kones. veim ratza lehotzi, yotzi. met pikkeach baal happikkachat, ma yaase fikkeach baal chereshet, o choletz o meyabbem.
14.9: Shene achim, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuim lishte nachriyyot, achat chereshet veachat pikkachat, met cheresh baal chereshet, ma yaase fikkeach baal pikkachat, kones. veim ratza lehotzi, yotzi. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet, kones, veeno motzi leolam:

15.1: Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam, shalom beno levenah veshalom baolam, uvata veamra, met bali, tinnase. met bali, tityabbem. shalom beno levenah umilchama vaolam, ketata veno levenah veshalom baolam, uvata veamra, met bali, enah neemenet. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam enah neemenet, ella im ken bata vocha uvegadeha keruin. amru lo, achat zo veachat zo, tinnase:
15.2: Bet hillel omrim, lo shamanu ella bevaa min hakkatzir, uveotah medina, uchemaase shehaya. amru lahen bet shammay, achat habbaa min hakkatzir, veachat habbaa min hazzetim, veachat habbaa min habbatzir, veachat habbaa mimmedina limdina. lo dibberu chachamim bakkatzir ella vahove. chazru vet hillel lehorot kevet shammay:
15.3: Bet shammay omrim, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah. bet hillel omrim, tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah. amru lahen bet shammay, hittartem erva chamura, lo tattiru et mamon hakkal. amru lahen bet hillel, matzinu sheen haachim nichnasim lannachala al piha. amru lahem bet shammay, vahalo missefer ketubbatah nilmod, shehu chotev lah, sheim tinnasi leacher, titteli ma shekkatuv lichi. vechazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
15.4: Hakkol neemanim lahaidah, chutz mechamotah, uvat chamotah, vetzaratah, vivimtah, uvat balah. ma ben get lemita, shehakketav mochiach. ed omer met, venisset, uva acher veamar lo met, hare zo lo tetze. ed omer met, ushenayim omrim lo met, af al pi shennisset, tetze. shenayim omrim met, veed omer lo met, af al pi shello nisset, tinnase:
15.5: Achat omeret met veachat omeret lo met, zo sheomeret met tinnase vetittol ketubbatah. vezo sheomeret lo met lo tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah. achat omeret met veachat omeret neherag, rabbi meir omer, hoil umachchishot zo et zo, hare ellu lo yinnaseu. rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim, hoil vezo vazo modot sheeno kayyam, yinnaseu. ed omer met veed omer lo met, ishsha omeret met veishsha omeret lo met, hare zo lo tinnase:
15.6: Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam, uvaa veamra met bali, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vetzaratah asura. hayta vat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziatta mide avera, ad shettehe asura linnase, vaasura milleechol batteruma:
15.7: Amra met bali veachar kach met chami, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vachamotah asura. hayta vat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziatta mide avera, ad shettehe asura linnase, vaasura leechol batteruma. kiddesh achat mechamesh nashim veeno yodea ezo kiddesh, kol achat omeret oti kiddesh, noten get lechol achat veechat, umanniach ketubba benehen umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziattu mide avera, ad sheyyitten get uchetubba lechol achat veechat. gazal echad mechamishsha veen yodea meeze gazal, kol echad omer oti gazal, manniach gezela benehen umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziattu mide avera, ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad:
15.8: Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvenah immahem, uvaa veamra met bali veachar kach met beni, neemenet. met beni veachar kach met bali, enah neemenet, vechoshshim lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:
15.9: Nittan li ven bimdinat hayyam, veamra met beni veachar kach met bali, neemenet. met bali veachar kach met beni, enah neemenet, vechoshshim lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:
15.10: Nittan li yavam bimdinat hayyam, amra met bali veachar kach met yevami, yevami veachar kach bali, neemenet. halcha hi uvalah vivamah limdinat hayyam, amra met bali veachar kach met yevami, yevami veachar kach bali, enah neemenet. sheen haishsha neemenet lomar met yevami, shettinnase. velo, meta achoti, shettikkanes leveto. veen haish neeman lomar met achi, sheyyeyabbem ishto. velo, meta ishti, sheyyissa achotah:

16.1: Haishsha shehalach balah vetzaratah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah met balech, lo tinnase velo tityabbem, ad shetteda shemma meubberet hi tzaratah. hayta lah chamot, enah chosheshet. yatzta melea chosheshet. rabbi yehoshua omer, enah chosheshet:
16.2: Shete yevamot, zo omeret met bali vezo omeret met bali, zo asura mippene valah shel zo vezo asura mippene valah shel zo. lazo edim velazo en edim, et sheyyesh lah edim, asura. veet sheen lah edim, mutteret. lazo vanim velazo en banim, et sheyyesh lah banim, mutteret. veet sheen lah banim, asura. nityabbemu umetu hayevamin, asurot lehinnase. rabbi elazar omer, hoil vehutteru layvamin, hutteru lechol adam:
16.3: En meidin ella al partzuf panim im hachotem, af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvechelav. en meidin ella ad shettetze nafsho, vaafillu rauhu meguyyad, vetzaluv, vehachayya ochelet bo. en meidin ella ad shelosha yamim. rabbi yehuda ben bava omer, lo chol haadam velo chol hammakom velo chol hashshaot shavin:
16.4: Nafal lemayim, ben sheyyesh lahen sof, ben sheen lahen sof, ishto asura. amar rabbi meir, maase veechad shennafal levor haggadol, veala leachar shelosha yamim. amar rabbi yose, maase vesuma sheyyarad litbol bimara, veyarad moshcho acharav, veshahu chede shettetze nafsham, vehissiu neshotehem. veshuv maase veasya beechad sheshshilsheluhu layyam, velo ala veyadam ella raglo, amru chachamim, min haarkubba ulemala, tinnase. min haarkubba ulematta, lo tinnase:
16.5: Afillu shama min hannashim omrot, met ish peloni, dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu shama min hattinokot omrim, hare anu holchin lispod velikvor et ish peloni, ben shehu mitkavven uven sheeno mitkavven. rabbi yehuda ven bava omer, beyisrael ad sheyyehe mitkavven. uvegoy, im haya mitkavven, en eduto edut:
16.6: Meidin leor hanner uleor hallevana, umassiin al pi vat kol. maase veechad sheamad al rosh hahar veamar, ish peloni ven peloni mimmakom peloni met, halchu velo matzu sham adam, vehissiu et ishto. veshuv maase vetzalmon beechad sheamar, ani ish peloni ben ish peloni, neshachani nachash, vahare ani met, vehalchu velo hikkiruhu, vehissiu et ishto:
16.7: Amar rabbi akiva, kesheyyaradti linhardea leabber hashshana, matzati nechemya ish bet deli, amar li, shamati sheen massiin et haishsha veeretz yisrael al pi ed echad, ella rabbi yehuda ven bava. venumeti lo, ken haddevarim. amar li, emor lahem mishshemi, attem yodim shehammedina meshubbeshet bigyasot, mekubbelani merabban gamliel hazzaken, shemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad. ucheshebbati vehirtzeti haddevarim lifne rabban gamliel, samach lidvaray, veamar, matzanu chaver lerabbi yehuda ven bava. mittoch haddevarim nizkar rabban gamliel, shennehergu harugim betel arza, vehissi rabban gamliel hazzaken neshotehem al pi ed echad, vehuchzeku lihyot massiin al pi ed echad. vehuchzeku lihyot massiin ed mippi ed, mippi eved, mippi ishsha, mippi shifcha. rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omrim, en massiin et haishsha al pi ed echad. rabbi akiva omer, lo al pi ishsha, velo al pi eved velo al pi shifcha, velo al pi kerovim. amru lo, maase vivne levi shehalchu letzoar ir hattemarim, vechala achad mehem badderech, veheviuhu vefundak, uvachazaratam amru lappundakit ayye chaverenu, amra lahem met ukevartiv, vehissiu et ishto. amru lo, velo tehe chohenet kappundakit. amar lahem, lichshettehe pundakit neemenet. happundakit hotzia lahem maklo vetarmilo vesefer tora shehaya veyado:
